_header.purpose: Reference copy of the deleted public.statutory_rate_config seed rows, kept for the future HR module rebuild. PLAN.md §0.5.
_header.warning: KNOWN WRONG: LRA-HR's statutory.ts:35 maps salary to an SSS Monthly Salary Credit bracket with Math.floor(salary/500)*500, but the real SSS schedule brackets on midpoints, not on the floor. That formula is one bracket low for roughly half of all salaries, so it chronically under-remits SSS contributions. payroll.test.ts:92 currently asserts the wrong answer and locks the bug in. Whoever rebuilds HR must get the real 2026 SSS contribution table (as brackets, not a formula) from the accountant before this config is used for a live payroll run. Do not trust the sss row below beyond its shape.

config_json.note: Salary is mapped to the nearest MSC bracket, then employee share = MSC x employee_rate. Amounts above the MPF threshold route to the Mandatory Provident Fund portion.

rates.notes: SSS contribution schedule. VERIFY against latest SSS circular before live payroll. See _header.warning: the bracket-mapping formula this config was paired with is known wrong.

config_json.note: Monthly premium = basic salary x premium_rate, clamped between floor and ceiling, then split 50/50.

rates.notes: PhilHealth premium schedule. VERIFY against latest PhilHealth advisory.

config_json.note: Salary at or below low_threshold uses the low rate. Contribution base is capped at monthly_fund_salary_cap.

rates.notes: Pag-IBIG contribution schedule. VERIFY against latest HDMF circular.

config_json.note: Taxable income = gross compensation minus statutory contributions minus non-taxable benefits. De minimis and the 13th month exemption are applied before this table.
